script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Romance
Theme: second chances

Begin screenplay.

Title: LOVE'S SECOND CHANCE

FADE IN:

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

The aroma of freshly brewed coffee fills the quaint, rustic coffee shop. AUGUST WEST (30s, ruggedly handsome) sits alone at a table, the morning paper spread in front of him.

WAITRESS (20s, cheerful) enters, carrying a steaming mug.

WAITRESS
(friendly)
Your usual, August?

AUGUST
(smiling)
Yes, please.

She places the mug in front of him and collects his payment. As she turns to leave, she hesitates.

WAITRESS
(softly)
Hey, do you have a minute?

INT. COFFEE SHOP - SEATING AREA

They sit down on a worn-out sofa in the corner.

WAITRESS
(nervously)
I saw your engagement announcement in the paper a few months ago. Congratulations.

AUGUST
(surprised)
Oh, thank you. It's been a whirlwind, but I'm happy.

WAITRESS
(hesitant)
Well, I have to admit something. We went to high school together, and... I've always had a crush on you. I know it's not fair, but I couldn't help it.

AUGUST
(taken aback)
(pauses)
I, uh, I went to high school with someone else. I never even knew you had a crush on me.

WAITRESS
(shrugs)
It's water under the bridge, I guess. But, I couldn't let this opportunity pass without telling you.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - KITCHEN

The waitress, EVELYN, prepares a latte with a thoughtful expression.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Evelyn returns to the table with the latte and places it in front of August.

EVELYN
(smiling)
Here you go. On the house.

AUGUST
(stunned)
(pauses)
Why?

EVELYN
(sincerely)
Because sometimes, it takes a second chance to realize what we truly want.

INT. AUGUST'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

August sits on his living room couch, the morning paper in hand. He reflects on their conversation and the latte Evelyn had given him.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

The next day, August enters the coffee shop and sees Evelyn behind the counter. He approaches her, holding out the newspaper.

AUGUST
(smiling)
I found this article. I thought you might want to read it.

Evelyn takes the paper and scans the article about a successful new business venture she has started.

EVELYN
(excited)
Wow, I can't believe it! Thanks for bringing this to my attention, August.

AUGUST
(smiling)
(pauses)
I was hoping we could celebrate. Maybe after work?

Evelyn nods in agreement, and they exchange knowing smiles.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - EVENING

August and Evelyn sit in a cozy booth, enjoying a well-deserved meal together. They share stories, laugh, and reminisce about their shared past.

EVELYN
(smiling)
I'm glad I got a second chance to know you, August.

AUGUST
(gently)
And I'm glad I got a second chance to know you, Evelyn.

They share a tender moment, their hands brushing together.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - NIGHT

As they leave the coffee shop, the sun sets, casting a warm glow over the quaint, rustic establishment.

FADE OUT.

THE END.
